evidence.observedFact: Bella Donna requires a credit card on file when scheduling multiple appointments, charges 50% for appointments not canceled with 24 hours notice, and charges 100% for no-call/no-show appointments.
Bella Donna actively offers online appointment booking, gift certificates and a new-client offer of $20 off a first service over $50.
Bella Donna sells multiple spa packages plus general gift cards that can be used for services and that expire two years after purchase.
Bella Donna publishes current operating hours, online booking and a public business phone number at its Painesville location.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate appointment reminders, confirmation nudges and recovery workflows designed to reduce late cancellations and no-shows without changing the salon's booking policy.
Create permission-based comeback campaigns for first-time clients, gift-card recipients and package purchasers who have not returned within an appropriate service interval.
Test a measurable repeat-visit rewards layer that complements existing gift cards and first-visit promotions; absence of a visible loyalty program is treated only as a sales hypothesis.

recommendedEntryOffer: Booking Recovery + Client Reactivation Revenue Engine
notes: Observed facts show appointment-loss controls, gift-card/package sales and a first-visit acquisition offer. The hypothesis is that Places Rewards can add automated repeat-visit and reactivation workflows around those existing systems. No monetary loss is claimed, and lack of a visible loyalty program is not treated as proof of lost revenue.
